# Complete the preserved isometry-transfer checkpoint

Fresh Sol/Ultra orc, ONE bounded commit-hygiene task. MAIN retains atomic
main-fix586; the preceding prover is retired. Work ONLY in
/home/drx/MIPStarRE-qpbt/.worktrees/issue-586-concrete-soundness-isometries.
HEAD9f58154bd67881bc329bb1f06f03ecbec0ece64f; MERGE_HEAD
78624dcf58479465af855d8435e65272ea177c7c. Nine paths are staged, no unmerged
index entries. Do not discard or reconstruct the staged merge or proofs.

Read /tmp/issue586-concrete-isometry-20260918-receipt.md and manifest,
/tmp/issue586-commit.log, applicable AGENTS/formalization/proof-debt naming
rules, and the relevant auxiliary blueprint statement. Normal hooks remain
binding. Owner single-key native rules: no codex exec, dispatch.sh, review.sh,
autofix, lanes, descendants, other keys, primary writes or GitHub actions.
All workflow tools are through PRIMARY /home/drx/MIPStarRE-qpbt/local/bin.

The actual required mathematics already type-checks: squared state <=delta,
both complete Pauli-family distances <=4*delta, and the combined bound
max(sqrt(delta),4*delta), with standard-only axiom closures. These proofs were
RECOVERED from original536checkpoint8d63d8a761e9f70463d578cbe5b286b9de81e5b2,
then adapted to existing APIs; do not reprove or change them. The original
900s proof/preservation task ended in an uncommitted checkpoint, actual
969.869s including69.869s overrun. This task does not renew that proof budget.

Resolve the specific commit blocker: the blueprint links the conditional
paper-like name pauli_soundness_ofExtractionWitness, which the proof-debt
hook rejects. This is a concrete auxiliary transformation of supplied
ExtractionWitness data, not the source pauli_soundness theorem. Give it a
distinct, descriptive auxiliary name, update its internal consumer and
blueprint link, and keep its supplied-witness assumptions fully explicit in
both Lean and blueprint. A property in the ExtractionWitness namespace may
express that role clearly. Inspect the policy and actual statement before
choosing the name. Do not merely conceal a load-bearing unproved hypothesis
or rename a source theorem to evade the hook. Source pauli_soundness, its
original sorry, source-domain qualifications and all markers stay unchanged.

Also remove the known new-file StateTransfer.lean style.openClassical warning
using local classical support where required; do not add blanket linter
disables or new public assumptions, and do not rewrite the mathematics.
The newly added transfer modules should pass their focused Lean checks
without this avoidable warning. Preserve the two input histories, recovered
proof provenance and all other staged content. No new proof task, new
abstraction, larger source theorem, source-game repair or scope expansion.

Validate changed modules and root import, the same new axiom closures under
the final names, exact statement equivalence apart from names, blueprint
links/sync and the actual rejected proof-debt check. Refresh the ignored
declaration index serially after any render. Run normal commit hooks and
finish the existing merge with both parents retained. No --no-verify, full
lake build, ci.sh, publication, status or independent review. Record failed
diagnostics and their resolutions without overwriting the original logs.

Budget360s from actual task_started, final120s for checks, commit and receipt.
No automatic retry or extension. If the policy issue requires mathematical
changes, stop with a precise checkpoint rather than weakening the contract.
Write /tmp/issue586-commit-hygiene-20260918-receipt.md and
/tmp/issue586-commit-hygiene-20260918-manifest.sha256: exact parents/head,
name mapping, preserved statements/proofs, changed paths, checks/logs/hashes
and truthful unpublished publication handoff. Prior123/241/529 and586 costs
remain cumulative. Finish this one task and stop for retirement.
